Why it went unnoticed

    

      A mode gate that silently evaluates false has no symptom of its own. Nothing errors and
      nothing logs — the prompts simply keep appearing, which reads as "the flag doesn't work"
      rather than "the helper is dead." isBypassMode survived only because it
      happened to carry a snake_case fallback its own comment described as defensive; that
      fallback was doing 100% of the work. Its two siblings had no fallback and no consumers
      loud enough to notice.
